answer_1.quote: We propose Prompted Aspect Key Point Analysis (PAKPA)... employing abstractive summarization for opinion quantification... PAKPA outperforms other baselines across all metrics, capturing approximately 66% (sR = 0.66) of the viewpoints expressed in manually annotated aspect-specific summaries.
answer_1.outputs: concise key point summaries (KPs) with quantified prevalence

answer_2.quote: We first perform a lexical comparison between generated KPs and the ground truth by computing the highest ROUGE score... we employ the set-level KPG evaluation... We use state-of-the-art semantic similarity evaluation methods and BARTScore as f max.

answer_4.quote: We conducted pairwise comparison of KPs from different systems using Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk)... We manually evaluated the information quality of generated KPs considering 7 different dimensions...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to compare two sets of KPs on each dimension (e.g., coverage, faithfulness, redundancy, validity, sentiment, informativeness, single‑aspect) and choose the better one.
